exposure: size of perinatal medical care center
labor at regional perinatal medical care centers
cohort: Children with severe cerebral palsy born in Japan from 2009 to 2012, compared to a control group of newborns without cerebral palsy
finding: Labor on weekends, during the night shift, and at regional perinatal medical care centers was associated with a significantly elevated risk for cerebral palsy in emergency cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections performed on weekends and during the night shift were associated with a significantly higher risk for cerebral palsy.
